scope: Primary-source audit of claims adjacent to bounded geography-conditioned weather states for county outage-stock forecasting.

sources.title: Quantifying Grid Resilience Against Extreme Weather Using Large-Scale Customer Power Outage Data
occupied_claims: learned discounted histories of multiple weather variables
spatial outage interaction with decaying kernels
sources.transfer_limit: Three-hour HRRR/service-territory Poisson model and mostly one-step evaluation are not the same estimand or information set as a 144-hour county-stock rollout.

sources.title: Global-Decision-Focused Neural ODEs for Proactive Grid Resilience Management
sources.transfer_limit: The real-data study uses one Massachusetts Nor'easter sequence and does not establish geography-conditioned ordered latent weather pathways or cross-event public-data transfer.

sources.title: Neural Controlled Differential Equations for Irregular Time Series
occupied_claims: general learnable state driven by a multivariate observation path
sources.transfer_limit: A generic Neural CDE does not itself impose outage-stock conservation, bounded interpretable proxy states, or geography-specific falsification tests.

sources.title: Universal Differential Equations for Scientific Machine Learning
occupied_claims: mechanistic differential equations augmented by learned closures
forced, delayed, stochastic, and constrained learned dynamics
sources.transfer_limit: This is a general SciML formalism, not an outage-specific empirical result.

sources.title: Antecedent rainfall, wind direction and seasonal effects may amplify the risk of wind-driven power outages in the UK
occupied_claims: antecedent rainfall, unusual wind direction, and season jointly modify wind-outage risk
explicit warning that association and causation are not equivalent
sources.transfer_limit: Region-level fault-exceedance classification with proprietary fault data is not an hourly customer-outage trajectory model.

rejected_as_standalone_novelty: learned weather memory or temporal ordering
claim_gate.candidate_contribution_if_supported: A small, predeclared bounded process graph inside a customer-conserving county rollout, evaluated on auditable public data with capacity-matched generic path-state controls and fresh county/event transfer tests.
required_controls: Zhu-style discounted multi-weather accumulation plus static vulnerability
true, matched-donor, and permuted geography interventions
